page.layout: Running head at top, printed page number 37 at top right. One column of running text, with no headings and no marginal notes. Catchword at the lower right. Signature "C 3" at the foot, left of centre. Faint show-through marks in the right margin, which are left out.

main_text.p: quendam prona, peninsulaque ad figu-ram accedens, hinc mari, inde lacu ma-ximâ sui parte cingitur. Isthmus, quo Africa jungitur, patet in latitudinem stadia xxv. Sitaque est in hujus spacii latere, quod vergit ad mare, Vtica modico ab urbe intervallo: in altero secundum lacum est Tunes. Ad quae duo loca cum mercenarii castra admovissent, & Carthaginienses à caeterâ regione exclu-sissent, ipsi jam Carthagini imminebant: ac modo interdiu, modò noctu ad muros accedentes metu & trepidatione maximâ intus omnia miscebant. Idem Polybius paulò pòst sic ait, de Amilcare d[?]ce loquens: Cervix illa, qua Afri Carthaginem jungit, colles terrenos ipsâ commissione habet difficiles & ar-duos: inque his arte munitâ sunt viâ, per quas in regionem patet transitus. Tunc autem Matho (hic hostium dux erat) omnia bello oportuna loca in illis collibus firmata præsidiis custodiebat. Ad hæc, quum Macar fluv. locis nonnullis similiter transitum impediat iis, qui ex urbe in regionem tendunt, ac propter aquarum copiam vado ut plurimum transfiri nequeat, Matho pontem ei amni impo-situm, qui est unicus, magnâ diligentiâ tuebatur, urbe etiam ad illum extructâ: ex quo fiebat, ut non solum exercitus in regio-

page.notes: Italic and roman type are judged from the scan: the Latin quoted from Polybius is set in italic and the author's narration in roman; the boundary at "Idem Polybius" and the italic extent are uncertain. "d[?]ce" at the line break after "d" is not legible with certainty. Faint show-through marks in the right margin (around the middle and lower part) are not printed text and are left out. The left edge contains only the neighbouring page and is left out. The catchword "regio-" and the signature "C 3" are as printed.
